name: Frame Window Counter
description: Shows the frame window (how many frames you had to click) for every gamemode, sorted into buckets, resetting each attempt.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the frame window counter during levels.

show-counts.name: Show counts
show-counts.description: Show the number column on the right. Turn off to show only the frame ranges.

tps.name: TPS (ticks per second)
tps.description: Physics speed used to turn frames into milliseconds. 240 = normal GD, 480 = double. Example: a 10 frame window is 41.67 ms at 240 TPS (24Hz frame perfect) and 20.83 ms at 480 TPS (48Hz).

hazard-distance.name: Hazard distance
hazard-distance.description: A click only counts if a hazard (or block) is at most this many units ahead of the wave. 60 = 2 blocks. Regular spam with nothing close is not counted.

include-blocks.name: Count blocks as hazards
include-blocks.description: The wave also dies on the side of blocks, so blocks count as hazards too. Turn off to use only spikes and saws. Takes effect when you enter a level.

player-hitbox-size.name: Player hitbox size
player-hitbox-size.description: 0 = automatic: use the game's own player rectangle for the current gamemode (recommended). A number (4-40) forces that size in units instead.

show-hardest.name: Show hardest click
show-hardest.description: Off: the popup shows the latest click. On: it shows the smallest window of the attempt.

ding.name: Ding sound
ding.description: Play a short ding every time a click is counted.

show-circles.name: Show circles on the level
show-circles.description: Draw a circle with the frame number where the player was at every click. The color matches the row in the counter. They disappear when you start a new attempt.

show-hz.name: Show Hz line
show-hz.description: Add a third line to the popup with the frame-perfect tick rate (for example 60Hz for a 4 frame window at 240 TPS).

popup-stay.name: Keep popup until next click
popup-stay.description: On: the popup does not fade, it stays until your next click (like the reference video). Off: it fades out.

popup-hold.name: Popup: time shown (s)
popup-hold.description: How long the popup stays fully visible after a click before it starts fading.

row-spacing.name: Row spacing
row-spacing.description: Space between the rows of the counter. Smaller = takes fewer pixels on screen.

hud-scale.name: Size
hud-scale.description: Size of the counter on screen.
